title: Nero’s skills
summary: Skills you can use during a run.

sections.note: The skill names and descriptions below come from the skill table; the in-game guide pairs the names Cat’s Eye and Feline Flurry the other way round.

rows.text: Highlights one combination of blocks that adds up to 10.
rows.sub: An enlightened Nero finds a combo in the cargo space that can be cleared.

rows.text: Pauses the timer and gives every block on the board a new random number.
rows.sub: An excited Nero reassigns the numbers on the blocks in the cargo space at random.

rows: 7 days after the event opens, then use any skill 1 time(s)

rows.text: Turns all blocks into fish; tap one and it is cleared at once, then the rest change back.
rows.sub: A hungry Nero snatches up a block and removes it from the cargo space.

rows: 14 days after the event opens, then use any skill 2 time(s) (after Cat's Eye is unlocked)
